mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.0% for two consecutive months indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeded 5.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand weakness, signaling reduced corporate revenue growth and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS declined, or interaction signal Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100) signal reduced industrial output, leading to lower corporate profitability and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of INDPRO < 100 instances, or regime-specific Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 3.0% year-over-year (CPIAUCSL) triggers monetary tightening expectations, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising non-farm payrolls trend (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of PAYEMS growth instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.5%) signal economic momentum slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of GDPC1 growth < 1.5% annualized instances, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production trend (INDPRO) over the prior quarter indicates manufacturing weakness, reducing corporate investment and profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of INDPRO decline instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
